description: This file contains unit tests for the NotificationsHandler class in an Android app. It verifies the behavior of notification listing, actions (dismiss, reply), validation, and rebind requests, using mock implementations of the NotificationsStateProvider.

classes.name: FakeNotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of NotificationsStateProvider used in tests to simulate notification state and actions.

methods.name: sampleEntry
methods.description: Creates a sample DeviceNotificationEntry with the specified key for testing.

methods.name: appContext
methods.description: Provides the application context for tests.

methods.name: parsePayload
methods.description: Parses the JSON payload from the GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: sanitizeNotificationText
methods.description: Sanitizes notification text by trimming and truncating to a maximum length.

methods.name: actionRequiresClearableNotification
methods.description: Determines if a notification action requires the notification to be clearable based on its kind.
